entries.grounds: CONFIRMED a real gap. mutant_view confirms the `**finding` spread is dropped, so when `deep` is non-empty bounded returns ONLY the marked deep fields. DEMONSTRATED divergence at the snapshot by importing the real (mutant) module and calling V.bounded on a finding with a valid shallow reproducer plus one deep field: PRISTINE -> keys {blocking,id,reproducer,severity,summary}, reproducer intact; MUTANT -> keys {summary} only (reproducer, id, severity, blocking all dropped).
